thread:
maria: FYI - multiple hosted customers hit 504s around 09:12 UTC for /v1/generate, looks autoscale-related. seeing gateway timeouts and long queue drains.
chris: Got alerts. Which pool/region?
maria: eu-west1 - backend pool "inference-eu-prod". Errors started when traffic spiked ~09:08.
devon: Logs show lots of ModelInit stalls on new pods, containers stuck in Init for >2m downloading artifacts. kubelet evicted init container once for OOM.
kai: HPA metrics show "req_queue_depth" stayed under threshold so no HPA scale until queue backlog hit gateway. KEDA ScaledObject had an annotation override that sets cooldown=120s — suspicious.
maria: Could the init image change from last deploy cause slower model fetch? We rolled a small image bump at 03:00.
chris: Confirmed image bump. New init container includes a different s3 client that opens fewer concurrent connections -> slower download.
devon: Repro attempt on staging: apply same image, send synthetic burst. Pods stay in Init state ~90s. HPA not scaling because measured metric is average over 60s and our scaler uses "queue_depth" with target 10, threshold logic delayed.
maria: So two contributors: slower init/warm and scaler cooldown/aggregation hiding short spikes. Root cause seems interplay of init time + KEDA/HPA sampling.
kai: Immediate mitigation: scale deployment minReplicas to 3 for affected pool and temporarily reduce KEDA cooldown/aggregation window. Patching now.
chris: Patch applied: minReplicas=3, scaledobject annotation cooldown->15s. Rolling updates to existing pods to restart init container (force re-pull).
oncall-bot: Incident acknowledged, paging policy: pager duty team paged.
marıa: (typo) re-checking customer side — status improves for 2 customers, others still see intermittent 504s.
devon: For remaining customers metric shows model load sometimes hits 1400MB memory spike causing OOMKilled for init; need to add retry/backoff in init or increase memory limit.
kai: Short-term: increase initContainer memory limit from 800Mi -> 1.5Gi for eu pool. Also enabling prefix-cache warmup on existing runner to reduce fetch size.
chris: Changes pushed. Observability: add a dashboard panel for initDuration and scaledobjectCooldown to catch this class.
sre-runbook-bot: Runbook excerpt: If 504s during burst, check (1) initDuration > 30s (2) scaledobject.cooldown > 30s (3) Scaler metric smoothing window > 60s. Temp mitigations: increase minReplicas, lower cooldown, bump init memory.
maria: Next actions: 1) revert s3 client change in init image and re-run controlled deploy 2) adjust KEDA scaler settings for eu-west to be less aggressive 3) follow up with model packaging team for smaller init footprint.
devon: I'll open a support case template and include repro steps. Repro (staging): 
```
# on staging cluster
kubectl apply -f image-bump-deployment.yaml
ab -n 200 -c 30 https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate
kubectl get pods -w -n inference | grep Init
kubectl logs pod/<init-pod> -c init
```
chris: Adding note for support: customers affected: cust-psi, beta-analytics, textract.ai — provided timeline and mitigation details.
maria: Marking incident status: mitigated->degraded. Will keep channel open until stable 1h. Thanks all. :bow:
